name: Magus Curse Weaver
body:
The blending of the arcane and the martial is a powerful tool, tempting to many. However, there are deeper magics that bind souls and the fates to the very bones of reality in the form of curses. A curse weaver has studied the ancient magics and learned to blend their dangerous power with the dire weapon skill they possess.

Spellcasting

A curse weaver uses the lathspell spell list along side the magus spell list, using the lower level of the two when the spell appears on both spell lists. This ability modifies spells but does not prevent another archetype that alters the magus’s spellcasting except for those that also replace the spell list.

Cursed Strike (Su)

At 1st level, the curse weaver can spend a point from their arcane pool as a swift action to infuse their weapon with the power of ancient curses. The charge remains on the weapon until the curse weaver hits and is triggered, or 1 minute. Once the curse weaver strikes a target with the charged weapon, they must make a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 the curse bearer’s class level + their Intelligence modifier). On a failure, the curse is triggered and suffer one of the curse options of minor bestow curse for 1 minute. On a successful save, the curse is not triggered and the weapon remains charged.

At 4th level, this becomes lesser bestow curse or a lesser curse spell. At 8th level, target is instead affected by one of the curse options from bestow curse for 1 minute and at 14th level, this becomes greater bestow curse or a lesser curse spell for 1 minute.

This ability replaces spell combat, improved spell combat, and greater spell combat.

Curse Infusion (Su)

At 2nd level, when using spell strike, the curse weaver may also deliver any spell with the curse descriptor regardless of range or a hex learned through their magus arcana, see below. This ability modifies spell strike.

Magus Arcana

When learning a magus arcana, the curse weaver may choose to learn a witch’s hex using their curse weaver class level as their witch level for its effects and prerequisites.
